_comment: Beam counts read off REAL scanned cells by eye (Sean, 2026-08-28). The
LilyPond reference sheet gives exact truth on clean engraving; this gives
truth on the degraded, dense material the reference sheet cannot imitate.
Six cells only — small on purpose — chosen to span the risk, including two
where the detector reports zero, which is where a recall loss would hide.
Counting rule given: count beam BARS. Two eighths joined = 1; a group of
four sixteenths (primary + secondary) = 2. Slurs, ties, ledger lines and
tuplet brackets are NOT beams — a tuplet bracket is a bracket, and counting
it would corrupt the duration inference that reads beam counts.
The predictions were withheld until after the counts were given.
What this established: the earlier collapse from 249 beams to 19 on Mahler
was PRECISION, not lost recall — both zero-cells are confirmed zero. It
also found a residual false-positive class the synthetic sheet could not:
ledger lines readmitted because the vertical strokes of sharps and naturals
were being counted as the two stems a beam needs.

cells.note: labeler excluded a few beams belonging to the measure below that intrude on this crop, so the true count for the full cell region may be slightly higher
